spec.title: TrueNAS · Mission Control
spec.description: Flagship TrueNAS SCALE dashboard fed by the truenas-scale-api-prometheus-exporter. Overview answers 'is my NAS OK?' in seconds, Incident puts everything failing on one screen, and the remaining tabs group the full metric surface by concern. Grey N/A always means 'no data / not present', never healthy. Generated by build_mission_control.py.

links.title: ← Operations Center (classic)
links.tooltip: Open the original TrueNAS Operations Center dashboard

spec.title: Is my NAS OK?
spec.description: Worst of: exporter reachability, middleware ready, pool and boot-pool health, outstanding (non-dismissed) alerts, fullest pool (80/90 %), hottest disk (45/55 °C) and data freshness (5/15 min). See 'Health checks' for which one fired. N/A means no data at all.

spec.expr: max(label_replace(2 * (1 - min(truenas_up{instance=~"$instance"})), "check", "Exporter reachable", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (1 - min(truenas_system_ready{instance=~"$instance"})), "check", "Middleware ready", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (1 - min(truenas_pool_healthy{instance=~"$instance"})), "check", "All pools healthy", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (1 - min(truenas_boot_pool_healthy{instance=~"$instance"})), "check", "Boot pool healthy", "", "") or label_replace(clamp_max(clamp_min(sum(truenas_alert_count{instance=~"$instance"}) - (sum(truenas_alert_dismissed_count{instance=~"$instance"}) or on() vector(0)), 0), 1), "check", "No outstanding alerts", "", "") or label_replace((max(100 * truenas_pool_allocated_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} / (truenas_pool_size_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} > 0)) > bool 80) + (max(100 * truenas_pool_allocated_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} / (truenas_pool_size_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} > 0)) > bool 90), "check", "Pools below 80 % / 90 %", "", "") or label_replace((max((truenas_disk_temperature_celsius{instance=~"$instance", disk=~".*", disk!="total"} > 0)) > bool 45) + (max((truenas_disk_temperature_celsius{instance=~"$instance", disk=~".*", disk!="total"} > 0)) > bool 55), "check", "Disks below 45 / 55 °C", "", "") or label_replace(((time() - max(truenas_last_scrape_timestamp_seconds{instance=~"$instance"})) > bool 300) + ((time() - max(truenas_last_scrape_timestamp_seconds{instance=~"$instance"})) > bool 900), "check", "Data fresh (< 5 / 15 min)", "", ""))

spec.title: CPU
spec.description: Average CPU utilisation. Click to open Compute.

spec.title: RAM excl. ARC
spec.description: Memory used by the OS, services, apps and VMs: used minus the ZFS ARC, as a share of physical RAM. The ARC is cache that ZFS releases under pressure, so it is excluded here. Click to open Compute.

spec.title: Fullest pool
spec.description: Used share of the fullest pool. Click to open Pools & ZFS.

spec.title: Hottest disk
spec.description: Highest disk temperature; 0 °C readings (no sensor) are ignored. Click to open Disks & Hardware.

spec.title: Network
spec.description: Total receive + transmit across all interfaces. Click to open Network.

spec.title: Alerts
spec.description: Outstanding alerts: alert_count minus dismissed (alert_count includes dismissed alerts). Click to open Alerts & Jobs.

spec.title: ARC hit
spec.description: ZFS ARC demand-data hit rate from hits/s ÷ accesses/s. Click to open Pools & ZFS.

spec.title: Uptime
spec.description: Host uptime. Click to open Exporter & Config.

spec.title: Health checks
spec.description: Each component of the verdict above. ✓ OK, ⚠ attention, ✕ action needed.

spec.expr: label_replace(2 * (1 - min(truenas_up{instance=~"$instance"})), "check", "Exporter reachable", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (1 - min(truenas_system_ready{instance=~"$instance"})), "check", "Middleware ready", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (1 - min(truenas_pool_healthy{instance=~"$instance"})), "check", "All pools healthy", "", "") or label_replace(2 * (1 - min(truenas_boot_pool_healthy{instance=~"$instance"})), "check", "Boot pool healthy", "", "") or label_replace(clamp_max(clamp_min(sum(truenas_alert_count{instance=~"$instance"}) - (sum(truenas_alert_dismissed_count{instance=~"$instance"}) or on() vector(0)), 0), 1), "check", "No outstanding alerts", "", "") or label_replace((max(100 * truenas_pool_allocated_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} / (truenas_pool_size_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} > 0)) > bool 80) + (max(100 * truenas_pool_allocated_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} / (truenas_pool_size_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} > 0)) > bool 90), "check", "Pools below 80 % / 90 %", "", "") or label_replace((max((truenas_disk_temperature_celsius{instance=~"$instance", disk=~".*", disk!="total"} > 0)) > bool 45) + (max((truenas_disk_temperature_celsius{instance=~"$instance", disk=~".*", disk!="total"} > 0)) > bool 55), "check", "Disks below 45 / 55 °C", "", "") or label_replace(((time() - max(truenas_last_scrape_timestamp_seconds{instance=~"$instance"})) > bool 300) + ((time() - max(truenas_last_scrape_timestamp_seconds{instance=~"$instance"})) > bool 900), "check", "Data fresh (< 5 / 15 min)", "", "")

spec.title: Which pool fills first?
spec.description: Used share of each pool (allocated ÷ size).

spec.title: Days until full
spec.description: Projection of the last 7 days' growth per pool. 'Not growing' when allocation is flat or shrinking; short history gives rough estimates.

spec.title: Hottest disks
spec.description: Current temperature per disk, hottest first (0 °C = no sensor, hidden).

spec.title: Network throughput
spec.description: Receive (up) and transmit (down) per interface.

spec.title: CPU and memory pressure
spec.description: CPU %, RAM used excluding the ZFS ARC, and RAM including ARC (dashed, informational).

spec.title: Storage throughput
spec.description: Read (up) and write (down) across all disks. Uses per-disk series where the NAS reports them (25.10/26.0) and the aggregate disk="total" series on TrueNAS 27.

spec.expr: sum(((truenas_disk_read_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk=~".*", disk!="total"} >= 0) or ((truenas_disk_read_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} >= 0) unless on (instance) (truenas_disk_read_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"} >= 0))))

-1 * sum(((truenas_disk_write_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk=~".*", disk!="total"} >= 0) or ((truenas_disk_write_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} >= 0) unless on (instance) (truenas_disk_write_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"} >= 0))))

spec.title: Which apps use the most memory?

spec.description: Current alert classes (includes dismissed alerts).

spec.expr: count((truenas_service_enabled{instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance, service) (truenas_service_running{instance=~"$instance"} == 0)) or on() (0 * max(truenas_up{instance=~"$instance"} == 1))

spec.title: API failing
spec.description: API methods whose latest call failed.

spec.title: Errors 1h
spec.description: Collector errors in the last hour.

spec.title: Data age
spec.description: Seconds since the exporter last completed a poll.

spec.title: Realtime
spec.description: reporting.realtime subscription (feeds CPU, memory, network and ZFS ARC). Optional subscriptions such as virt.instance.metrics may be inactive on systems without that feature; see the Exporter tab.

spec.title: What needs attention right now?
spec.description: Everything currently failing or close to a limit, worst first. Empty means nothing needs attention.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(0 * (truenas_up{instance=~"$instance"} == 0) + 2, "kind", "Exporter cannot reach TrueNAS", "", ""), "item", "$1", "instance", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(0 * (truenas_pool_healthy{instance=~"$instance"} == 0) + 2, "kind", "Pool unhealthy", "", ""), "item", "$1", "pool", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(0 * (truenas_boot_pool_healthy{instance=~"$instance"} == 0) + 2, "kind", "Boot pool unhealthy", "", ""), "item", "—", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(0 * (truenas_directoryservices_fault_present{instance=~"$instance"} == 1) + 2, "kind", "Directory service faulted", "", ""), "item", "$1", "service", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(0 * (truenas_app_state{instance=~"$instance", state=~"CRASHED|ERROR"}) + 2, "kind", "App crashed", "", ""), "item", "$1", "app", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(0 * ((truenas_service_enabled{instance=~"$instance"} == 1) and on (instance, service) (truenas_service_running{instance=~"$instance"} == 0)) + 2, "kind", "Service enabled but stopped", "", ""), "item", "$1", "service", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(0 * (truenas_pool_warning{instance=~"$instance"} == 1) + 1, "kind", "Pool warning", "", ""), "item", "$1", "pool", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(0 * (100 * truenas_pool_allocated_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} / (truenas_pool_size_bytes{instance=~"$instance"} > 0) > 85) + 1, "kind", "Pool over 85 % full", "", ""), "item", "$1", "pool", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(0 * ((truenas_disk_temperature_celsius{instance=~"$instance", disk=~".*", disk!="total"} > 0) > 50) + 1, "kind", "Disk above 50 °C", "", ""), "item", "$1", "disk", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(0 * ((truenas_certificate_expiry_timestamp_seconds{instance=~"$instance"} - time()) < 30 * 86400) + 1, "kind", "Certificate expires within 30 days", "", ""), "item", "$1", "name", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(0 * (truenas_api_call_success{instance=~"$instance"} == 0) + 1, "kind", "API method failing", "", ""), "item", "$1", "method", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(0 * (clamp_min(sum(truenas_alert_count{instance=~"$instance"}) - (sum(truenas_alert_dismissed_count{instance=~"$instance"}) or on() vector(0)), 0) > 0) + 1, "kind", "Outstanding alerts in TrueNAS", "", ""), "item", "—", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(0 * (truenas_system_reboot_required{instance=~"$instance"} == 1) + 1, "kind", "Reboot required", "", ""), "item", "—", "", "")

spec.title: What changed in this time range?
spec.description: State flips inside the selected time range (count of changes). Widen the time range to look further back.

spec.expr: label_replace(label_replace(resets(truenas_host_uptime_seconds{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]) > 0, "kind", "Host rebooted", "", ""), "item", "—", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(changes(truenas_pool_healthy{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]) > 0, "kind", "Pool health changed", "", ""), "item", "$1", "pool", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(changes(truenas_service_running{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]) > 0, "kind", "Service started/stopped", "", ""), "item", "$1", "service", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(changes(truenas_interface_link_up{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]) > 0, "kind", "Link went up/down", "", ""), "item", "$1", "interface", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(changes(truenas_app_container_count{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]) > 0, "kind", "App containers changed", "", ""), "item", "$1", "app", "(.*)") or label_replace(label_replace(changes(truenas_alert_count{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]) > 0, "kind", "Alert count changed", "", ""), "item", "—", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(changes(truenas_update_available{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]) > 0, "kind", "Update availability changed", "", ""), "item", "—", "", "") or label_replace(label_replace(changes(truenas_up{instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]) > 0, "kind", "Exporter connectivity flapped", "", ""), "item", "$1", "instance", "(.*)")

defaults.noValue: No changes in this time range

spec.title: Alerts over time
spec.description: Outstanding vs dismissed alerts.

spec.title: Error rates
spec.description: API-call and collector error rates (errors per second).

spec.title: Exporter poll time
spec.description: How long each poll of the TrueNAS API takes; spikes precede stale data.

spec.title: How busy is the CPU?
spec.description: Total and per-core CPU usage. Look for a single core pinned near 100 % (single-threaded bottleneck).

spec.title: Load Average
spec.description: Load average vs CPU core count. Load above core count means queueing.

spec.title: CPU Temperature per Core
spec.description: Per-core CPU temperatures. Sustained high temps indicate cooling issues.

spec.title: CPU Time Breakdown
spec.description: User/system/iowait/IRQ/idle split. TrueNAS 25.10 and 26.0 report it; 27.0 sends total usage only (NaN here), so the panel stays empty there by design (D11).

spec.title: Total RAM
spec.description: Total physical RAM.

spec.title: RAM excl. ARC
spec.description: Memory used by the OS, services, apps and VMs: used minus the ZFS ARC, as a share of physical RAM. The ARC is cache that ZFS releases under pressure, so it is excluded here.

spec.title: RAM incl. ARC
spec.description: Raw 'used' share as TrueNAS reports it, including the reclaimable ZFS ARC. Informational: high values are normal on a NAS.

spec.title: Available
spec.description: Available RAM (free + reclaimable).

spec.title: ARC Size
spec.description: Current ZFS ARC size.

spec.title: ECC
spec.description: ECC memory present.

spec.title: Memory Capacity Over Time
spec.description: Physical memory from reporting.realtime. 'Used' includes the ZFS ARC; 'Used excl. ARC' is what services, apps and VMs hold.

spec.title: Documented ARC Memory Over Time
spec.description: ARC memory fields explicitly documented by reporting.realtime.

spec.title: Pool $pool
spec.description: Used share of this pool with its trend. Repeated for every pool selected in the Pool variable.

spec.title: Pool Count
spec.description: Number of pools.

spec.title: All Healthy
spec.description: Lowest pool health.

spec.title: Total Size
spec.description: Aggregate pool capacity.

spec.title: Total Free
spec.description: Aggregate free space.

spec.title: Snapshots
spec.description: Total ZFS snapshots.

spec.title: Oldest Snap
spec.description: Age of the oldest snapshot. Very old snapshots may waste space.

spec.title: Scrub Tasks
spec.description: Configured scrub tasks.

spec.title: Boot Pool
spec.description: Boot pool health.

spec.title: When will each pool be full?
spec.description: Linear projection of each pool's allocation trend over the last 7 days (predict_linear-style: free ÷ growth rate). Pools that are flat or shrinking show N/A. Needs a few hours of history; treat short-range estimates as rough.

spec.title: Pool Space Being Freed
spec.description: Bytes being freed by ongoing operations on TrueNAS26/27. Missing on unsupported or unavailable sources.

spec.title: Which pool fills first?
spec.description: Per-pool fill ratio. Pools above 80% suffer performance degradation.

spec.title: Top Dataset Utilization
spec.description: Datasets closest to filling their available space.

spec.title: How fast are pools growing?
spec.description: Pool allocated and free space over time for capacity planning.

spec.title: Pool Fragmentation
spec.description: Pool fragmentation over time. High fragmentation degrades performance.

spec.title: Pool Scan Progress
spec.description: Scrub/resilver progress per pool, clamped to 100 %: TrueNAS can report slightly over 100 % (e.g. 101.4) for a finished scan.

spec.title: Pool Inventory
spec.description: Pool capacity, health, dedup-table footprint, and active expansion progress.

spec.expr: 100 * max by (pool) (truenas_pool_allocated_bytes{instance=~"$instance", pool=~"$pool"}) / clamp_min(max by (pool) (truenas_pool_size_bytes{instance=~"$instance", pool=~"$pool"}), 1)

spec.title: Pool Expansion Progress
spec.description: Completion percentage for active pool expansion reflow.

spec.title: Pool Realtime I/O
spec.description: Per-pool read/write throughput from reporting.realtime. TrueNAS 27.0 sends pool capacity only; see Disk Throughput for I/O on 27.

spec.title: Snap Task Max
spec.description: Maximum number of snapshot tasks allowed.

spec.title: Snap Max Total
spec.description: Maximum total snapshot tasks allowed.

spec.title: Scrub Enabled
spec.description: Pools with an enabled scrub task.

spec.title: Pools Warning
spec.description: Pools currently flagging a warning.

spec.title: Scanning Now
spec.description: Pools with an active scrub/resilver scan (0 when none is running).

spec.title: Oldest Scan
spec.description: Age of the least-recently-scanned pool.

spec.title: Pool Status & Scrub Detail
spec.description: Pool status enum, v26 detailed status_code, warning flag, scrub-task enablement, and time since last scan.

spec.title: Pool Scan Bytes Progress
spec.description: Bytes processed vs. total for the last/active pool scrub or resilver scan.

spec.title: Pool Realtime Capacity
spec.description: Per-pool capacity from the reporting.realtime event stream.

spec.title: Pool Scan ETA
spec.description: Estimated seconds remaining in the active pool scan.

spec.title: Pool Scan Errors
spec.description: Errors found during the last/active pool scan.

spec.title: ARC Size
spec.description: Current documented ZFS ARC cache size.

spec.title: ARC Free
spec.description: ARC-reported free memory.

spec.title: ARC Avail
spec.description: ARC-reported available memory.

spec.title: L2ARC Hit %
spec.description: L2ARC hits/s ÷ accesses/s. N/A when there is no L2ARC device or no L2ARC traffic.

spec.title: Data Hit %
spec.description: Demand-data hits/s ÷ accesses/s (computed from rates; the upstream ratio field reads 0 on 27.0 RC.1).

spec.title: Meta Hit %
spec.description: Demand-metadata hits/s ÷ accesses/s (computed from rates).

spec.title: Demand Hit & Miss Rates
spec.description: Documented ARC demand-data and demand-metadata hit and miss rates.

spec.title: ARC Memory Headroom
spec.description: Documented ARC free and available memory fields.

spec.title: Demand & L2ARC Hit Ratios
spec.description: Cache hit percentages computed from hits/s ÷ accesses/s. Higher is better; gaps mean no accesses in that interval.

spec.title: Demand Data & Metadata Rates
spec.description: Demand access rates for data and metadata, including I/O-level hit rates.

spec.title: L2ARC Throughput
spec.description: L2ARC I/O. High write with low hit ratio signals cache churn.

spec.title: Top space consumers
spec.description: Datasets by documented used-space value.

spec.title: Datasets closest to their limit
spec.description: Datasets with least available space.

spec.title: Dataset Snapshot Counts
spec.description: Datasets with the most snapshots. Partial on TrueNAS 27: per-dataset counts cost one API call each, so the exporter fills at most DATASET_SNAPSHOT_FALLBACK_LIMIT datasets (default 25). See 'Snapshots' on the Pools tab for the total.

spec.title: Dataset Compression Ratio
spec.description: Compression ratio per dataset (1.00 = no savings).

spec.title: Where is snapshot space going?
spec.description: Datasets consuming the most space in snapshots.

spec.title: Datasets with Reservations
spec.description: Datasets with explicit ZFS reservations.

spec.title: Dataset Capacity Detail
spec.description: Detailed dataset capacity, encryption, quota, and snapshot info.

spec.expr: 100 * max by (dataset) (truenas_dataset_used_bytes{instance=~"$instance", dataset=~"$dataset"}) / clamp_min(max by (dataset) (truenas_dataset_used_bytes{instance=~"$instance", dataset=~"$dataset"}) + max by (dataset) (truenas_dataset_available_bytes{instance=~"$instance", dataset=~"$dataset"}), 1)

spec.title: Dataset Policy Detail
spec.description: Dataset encryption, policy flags, quota thresholds, and age.

spec.title: Disk Count
spec.description: Number of disks.

spec.title: Hottest Disk
spec.description: Highest disk temperature. Disks reporting 0 °C (no sensor, e.g. USB bridges) are ignored.

spec.title: Avg Busy
spec.description: Average disk busy %. TrueNAS 27 reports aggregate disk I/O only; this then shows one "total" series, and per-disk filters do not apply.

spec.expr: avg((truenas_disk_busy_percent{instance=~"$instance", disk=~"$disk", disk!="total"} or (truenas_disk_busy_percent{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} unless on (instance) truenas_disk_busy_percent{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"})))

spec.title: Disk Throughput by Device
spec.description: Read (up) and write (down) throughput for the busiest devices. TrueNAS 27 reports aggregate disk I/O only; this then shows one "total" series, and per-disk filters do not apply.

spec.expr: topk(8, ((truenas_disk_read_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk=~"$disk", disk!="total"} >= 0) or ((truenas_disk_read_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} >= 0) unless on (instance) (truenas_disk_read_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"} >= 0))))

-1 * topk(8, ((truenas_disk_write_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk=~"$disk", disk!="total"} >= 0) or ((truenas_disk_write_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} >= 0) unless on (instance) (truenas_disk_write_bytes_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"} >= 0))))

spec.title: Disk IOPS by Device
spec.description: Read (up) and write (down) IOPS per device. TrueNAS 27 reports aggregate disk I/O only; this then shows one "total" series, and per-disk filters do not apply.

spec.expr: topk(8, ((truenas_disk_read_ops_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk=~"$disk", disk!="total"} >= 0) or ((truenas_disk_read_ops_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} >= 0) unless on (instance) (truenas_disk_read_ops_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"} >= 0))))

-1 * topk(8, ((truenas_disk_write_ops_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk=~"$disk", disk!="total"} >= 0) or ((truenas_disk_write_ops_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} >= 0) unless on (instance) (truenas_disk_write_ops_per_second{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"} >= 0))))

spec.title: Which disks are saturated?
spec.description: Disk utilization saturation. TrueNAS 27 reports aggregate disk I/O only; this then shows one "total" series, and per-disk filters do not apply.

spec.expr: topk(8, ((truenas_disk_busy_percent{instance=~"$instance", disk=~"$disk", disk!="total"} >= 0) or ((truenas_disk_busy_percent{instance=~"$instance", disk="total"} >= 0) unless on (instance) (truenas_disk_busy_percent{instance=~"$instance", disk!="total"} >= 0))))

spec.title: Disk Temperature Over Time
spec.description: Per-disk temperatures over time (0 °C readings = no sensor, hidden).

spec.title: Hottest disks
spec.description: Current temperature per disk, hottest first. Disks reporting 0 °C (no sensor) are omitted.

spec.title: Disk Sizes
spec.description: Raw capacity per disk, largest first.

spec.title: Disk Inventory
spec.description: Per-disk capacity, performance, temperature and media type. On TrueNAS 27 the busy/throughput/IOPS columns are absent because 27 reports aggregate disk I/O only; temperature 0 °C (no sensor) is left blank.

spec.title: Disk Identity
spec.description: Disk model, serial number, and bus for each device.

spec.title: Peak Disk Temperature (~5 min max)
spec.description: Per-disk maximum from the aggregated (min/avg/max) temperature query, refreshed on the heavy-query cadence. Catches short spikes the instant reading misses.

spec.title: GPU Host Avail
spec.description: GPUs available to the TrueNAS host.

spec.title: GPU Critical
spec.description: GPUs using system-critical PCI devices.

spec.title: Physical Cores
spec.description: Host physical CPU cores (non-HT).

spec.title: Host & Chassis Identity
spec.description: Static host, system, CPU, chassis, hypervisor, and GPU identity labels.

spec.expr: label_replace(max by (hostname, version, product_type) (truenas_host_info{instance=~"$instance"}), "component", "Host", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max by (manufacturer, product) (truenas_host_system_info{instance=~"$instance"}), "component", "System", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max by (model) (truenas_host_cpu_info{instance=~"$instance"}), "component", "CPU", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max by (model) (truenas_chassis_hardware{instance=~"$instance"}), "component", "Chassis", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max by (variant) (truenas_hw_virt_variant{instance=~"$instance"}), "component", "Hypervisor", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(max by (index, model, vendor, pci_id) (truenas_gpu_info{instance=~"$instance"}), "component", "GPU", "__name__", ".*")

spec.title: Interfaces
spec.description: Network interface count.

spec.title: Gateway
spec.description: Applied default route is configured.

spec.title: Nameservers
